answers.value: Statement-I is incorrect (the atmosphere is heated mainly by terrestrial long-wave radiation, not by incoming solar radiation); Statement-II is correct
answers.reasoning: The atmosphere is largely transparent to incoming short-wave solar radiation, which passes through and heats the earth's surface; the surface then re-radiates energy as long-wave terrestrial radiation, which the atmosphere absorbs. So the atmosphere is heated more by terrestrial radiation than by incoming solar radiation, making Statement-I incorrect. Statement-II is correct and is in fact the reason Statement-I is wrong: carbon dioxide, water vapour and other greenhouse gases are good absorbers of long-wave radiation, which is why terrestrial radiation is the dominant heat source for the atmosphere.

Nitrous oxide is an inhaled anaesthetic, nitrogen dioxide is a toxic air pollutant, and nitrogen pentoxide is an unstable oxidising compound; none is made in the body as a vasodilator.

answers.value: Long duration energy storage

When electricity is cheap or surplus — typically at solar peak or overnight — water is pumped uphill; when demand peaks, it is released back down through turbines to generate power. It is therefore a way of storing energy in bulk for hours to days, and it remains by far the largest form of grid energy storage in the world, which is why it is discussed as the mainstay of long duration storage for balancing variable renewables. It is not an irrigation or rainwater-harvesting technique.

A motor vehicle is a physical or real asset used in production or consumption; it can be financed or leased, but the vehicle itself is not a financial contract.

answers.value: A writ of Prohibition is issued to a lower court or tribunal to stop it continuing proceedings beyond its jurisdiction

It is not available against an administrative officer acting in a non-judicial capacity, which rules out A and D, and it cannot be directed against a legislature at all, which rules out B. The remedy against a lower court's completed order is Certiorari, while Prohibition halts proceedings still under way.

answers.value: Only statement 2 is correct — private specialists may volunteer at government facilities, but the scheme is antenatal only and carries no six-month post-delivery component
answers.reasoning: Statement 2 is correct: the Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan invites private-sector obstetricians, gynaecologists and radiologists to volunteer their services at nearby government health facilities on the fixed day. Statement 1 is incorrect because of its tail: the scheme guarantees a fixed-day, free, assured and quality antenatal check-up on the ninth of every month to pregnant women in their second and third trimesters, and stops there — the six-months-post-delivery entitlement belongs to a different initiative, Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan, which covers mothers up to six months after delivery and sick newborns. Runner-up is C, which would win if the examiner reads statement 1 generously as a loose description of maternal-health assurance rather than holding it to the antenatal scope of this particular scheme.

answers.value: Statements 2 and 3 only — contribution is age-specific and the assured pension is Rs 3,000 a month from age 60; the entry age starts at 18, and family pension goes to the spouse alone
answers.reasoning: Statement 1 is incorrect: the entry age band for the Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan is 18 to 40 years, not 21 to 40. Statement 2 is correct: the monthly contribution rises with the age of entry, from about Rs 55 at eighteen to Rs 200 at forty, and is matched rupee for rupee by the Central Government. Statement 3 is correct: the scheme assures a minimum pension of Rs 3,000 per month once the subscriber attains sixty. Statement 4 is incorrect: family pension under the scheme is confined to the spouse, who receives fifty per cent of the pension, and children including unmarried daughters are not entitled to it. The surviving combination is 2 and 3.
